name: Tanuki
description: (Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:power)(Tag:race-change)Race Change - You are a Tanuki, a raccoon-dog yokai semi-spiritual being excelling in trickery. You shift between Tanuki, humanoid, and in-between forms. You possess increased energy reserves and increased affinity toward Stranger abilities and traits, letting you use and master them more easily and efficiently. You naturally use [Tanuki's Leaves (Rare)] without needing an ability slot.
